title: Future in the Past
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! El 'Future in the Past' es vital para explicar en reuniones por qué los planes cambiaron. Expresiones como 'We were going to launch...' o 'The CEO was about to sign...' te dan la precisión histórica necesaria en informes de proyectos.

parts.visual:
El 'Future in the Past' se usa para hablar de planes o intenciones que teníamos en el pasado (que a menudo no se cumplieron o cambiaron). 
1. Was/Were going to (Iba a): 
Ej: We WERE GOING TO launch the product in May, but it was delayed. (Íbamos a lanzarlo, pero se retrasó). 
2. Would (Para predicciones o promesas pasadas): 
Ej: They promised they WOULD deliver on time. (Prometieron que entregarían).
parts.audio: The 'Future in the Past' is used to talk about plans, intentions, or predictions we had in the past, which often didn't happen or changed. Number 1: 'Was or Were going to'. Example: We WERE GOING TO launch the product in May, but it was delayed. This means it was our plan, but things changed. Number 2: 'Would', used for past predictions or promises. Example: They promised they WOULD deliver on time.

parts.visual:
Estructuras más formales: 
3. Was/Were to + verbo (Había el plan oficial de / Estaba programado para): 
Ej: The CEO WAS TO SIGN the deal yesterday, but he fell ill. 
Ej: It WAS TO BE our biggest project ever. 
4. Was/Were about to (Estaba a punto de - acción inminente en el pasado): 
Ej: We WERE ABOUT TO close the office when the client called.
parts.audio: More formal structures. Number 3: 'Was or Were to' plus verb. This implies an official plan or schedule in the past. Example: The CEO WAS TO SIGN the deal yesterday, but he fell ill. Or: It WAS TO BE our biggest project ever. Number 4: 'Was or Were about to', used for imminent actions in the past. Example: We WERE ABOUT TO close the office when the client called. Meaning, we were on the verge of doing it.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de Future in the Past.

questions.question: I ____ to call you, but I got caught up in a meeting. (Iba a llamarte).
questions.explanation: Was going to = Iba a (plan no cumplido).

questions.question: The President ____ to visit the factory yesterday, but the flight was cancelled. (Estaba programado que visitara - formal).
questions.explanation: Was to visit = Estaba programado (arreglo oficial en el pasado).

questions.question: They assured us that the budget ____ be approved by Friday. (Aseguraron que sería aprobado).
questions.explanation: Promesa/predicción en el pasado: assured that it WOULD be.

questions.question: We were just ____ to sign the contract when they changed the terms. (Estábamos a punto de).
questions.explanation: Were about to = Estábamos a punto de (inminente).

questions.question: The merger ____ to be completed in Q3, but regulatory issues delayed it. (Estaba planeado/programado que se completara).
questions.explanation: Was to be completed = Estaba programado/destinado a completarse.

questions.question: I always knew that she ____ become the CEO one day. (Predicción pasada).
questions.explanation: Sabía que ella (en el futuro de ese pasado) se convertiría en CEO: WOULD become.

questions.question: They ____ going to invest in the startup, but they found a better opportunity. (Iban a).
The meeting ____ to start at 9 AM, but the projector broke. (Estaba programada para empezar).
He was ____ to leave for the airport when the phone rang. (Estaba a punto de).
questions.explanation: Was about to leave (acción inminente interrumpida).

questions.question: We thought the marketing campaign ____ increase sales by 20%. (Creíamos que aumentaría).
The new law ____ to take effect on January 1st, but it was postponed. (Estaba programada/destinada).
I ____ going to mention the error, but I decided not to. (Yo iba a mencionarlo).
The negotiators were ____ to reach an agreement when the talks collapsed. (Estaban a punto de).
She promised she ____ send the report by the end of the day. (Prometió que enviaría).
The delegates ____ to arrive at 10 AM, but their train was delayed. (Estaba programado que llegaran).
We ____ going to hire him, but his references were terrible. (Íbamos a contratarlo).
I thought the project ____ be a huge success. (Creía que sería).
The manager was ____ to announce the restructuring when the news leaked. (Estaba a punto de).
It ____ to be the tallest building in the city, but they ran out of funds. (Iba a ser / Estaba destinado a ser).
They told us the system ____ be ready by Monday. (Nos dijeron que estaría).
I ____ going to call you. (Iba a)
They promised they ____ deliver. (Prometieron que entregarían)
The CEO ____ to visit yesterday. (Estaba programado - formal)
We were ____ to sign when they called. (A punto de)
They ____ going to invest. (Iban a)
I knew she ____ win. (Sabía que ella ganaría)
It ____ to be a secret. (Estaba destinado a ser)
She was ____ to leave. (A punto de)
The delegates ____ to arrive at 10. (Estaba programado - plural)
We thought it ____ work. (Pensamos que funcionaría)

pairs.source: I was going to launch it
pairs.target: Yo iba a lanzarlo (pero no lo hice)
Estaba programado que el CEO firmara

pairs.source: It was to be a secret
pairs.target: Estaba destinado a ser un secreto

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase en Future in the Past correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I was going to call you.
options: I was going to call you.
I am going to call you.
I was going to call him.
questions.correct_answer: I was going to call you.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We were about to sign the deal.
options: We were about to sign the deal.
We are about to sign the deal.
They were about to sign the deal.
We were going to sign the deal.
questions.correct_answer: We were about to sign the deal.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The manager was to arrive at noon.
options: The manager was to arrive at noon.
The manager was arriving at noon.
A manager was to arrive at noon.
The manager is to arrive at noon.
questions.correct_answer: The manager was to arrive at noon.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They were going to invest heavily.
options: They were going to invest heavily.
They are going to invest heavily.
We were going to invest heavily.
They were going to invest early.
questions.correct_answer: They were going to invest heavily.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was to be a secret project.
options: It was to be a secret project.
It is to be a secret project.
It was to be a secret.
This was to be a secret project.
questions.correct_answer: It was to be a secret project.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The delegates were to meet us.
options: The delegates were to meet us.
The delegates are to meet us.
The delegates were to meet them.
questions.correct_answer: The delegates were to meet us.
